# Reliable Download Manager

A reliable, fast and resumable download manager for Windows and Linux, with a small and simple window.

**Status:** early development (v0.0.1). See [plan.md](../plan.md) and [step-by-step-development.md](../step-by-step-development.md).

## Planned features

- Multi-connection, segmented downloads for high speed
- Resume after pause, crash, restart or network loss
- Automatic retries
- Choose your own download folder (default: the system Downloads folder)
- Lightweight, instant start, no splash screen

## Availability (planned)

Microsoft Store · Flathub · Snapcraft
